def ttl_lru(maxsize=128, ttl=None, clock=time.monotonic):
    def deco(fn):
        data = OrderedDict()

                data.move_to_end(key)

            try:

            if len(data) > maxsize:
                data.popitem(last=False)

        def cache_info():
            return hits, misses, len(data)
